o.text: Borrowed from Russian тарака́н (tarakán), possibly a Turkic borrowing itself. Inheritance from an ancestor Turkic language would rather have yielded Azerbaijani *taraqan/*daraqan (or *tarağan/*darağan).
From Proto-Turkic *üĺi- (“to freeze, congeal; to blow (of a cold wind)”).
From Persian دماغ (damâġ), from Arabic دِمَاغ (dimāḡ).
